title: Current scoped implementation overlay for the historical PRD/TRD ledger
coverageMeaning: A mapping identifies implemented source and scoped historical or package evidence relevant to a requirement. It does not assert that every acceptance behavior is implemented, that historical tests reran on the reviewed source, or that any release/platform is qualified. Package remainingGates are binding for every linked row. Historical ledger statuses are preserved.

kernel.coveredScope: Canonical identities, transactional mutation services, owner lock, persistent jobs and current SQLite runtime.
kernel.remainingGates: Historical/service evidence does not qualify the latest binary. Windows new-workspace creation and migrations remain unavailable; target runtime and crash recovery remain open.

policy.coveredScope: Authenticated scoped services, revisions, idempotency and explicit approval of generated mutations.
policy.remainingGates: Real external-provider operations and candidate-specific hostile input/revocation journeys remain independently unqualified.

editor.coveredScope: Structured rich text, core blocks, preservation, clipboard and editor operations in existing implementation and targeted regressions.
editor.remainingGates: Actual native IME/VoiceOver/clipboard and all acceptance variants require candidate-specific evidence; browser fixtures are narrower.

table.coveredScope: Table structural controls and preserved rich-text cells.
table.remainingGates: Targeted fixture coverage does not establish native editor qualification.

rich-style.coveredScope: Canonical text colors/highlights across editor and import/export representations.
rich-style.remainingGates: Candidate/native and broader imported-span preservation remain separate gates.

presentation.coveredScope: Code/image presentation, bundled Shiki and PDF.js, equations and diagrams.
presentation.remainingGates: Native platform PDF/WebView behaviors and representative hostile documents remain separately qualified.

layout.coveredScope: Tabs, columns and reusable blocks with canonical identities and nested content preservation.
layout.remainingGates: Native editing and representative imported structures need candidate evidence.

online-content.coveredScope: Explicit cached bookmarks and consented sandboxed supported embeds.
online-content.remainingGates: Provider behavior and native consent/network containment require their own current checks; unrestricted embeds are outside the supported boundary.

navigation.coveredScope: Stable page/view navigation, source links, persisted toggle visibility, sidebar and search navigation.
navigation.remainingGates: Native deep-link launch routing, keyboard/accessibility and target lifecycle evidence remain separate.

database.coveredScope: Canonical records/properties, typed parameterized queries, cursor pagination, virtualization and persisted view controls.
database.remainingGates: Full property/view acceptance and large derived-value latency remain separate; 10k formula/rollup behavior is not a subsecond general guarantee.

timeline.coveredScope: Timeline scale, grouping and dependency/sub-item representation.
timeline.remainingGates: Native interaction and representative large dependency graphs remain candidate gates.

templates.coveredScope: Unified captured page body plus database property defaults with reviewed mapping.
templates.remainingGates: Unsupported/incompatible schemas remain explicit; native library workflows require candidate evidence.

formula.coveredScope: Published versioned formula contract, bounded evaluation and relation/rollup behavior.
formula.remainingGates: Only the declared compatibility subset is supported; captured source values are not live computed results, and representative performance remains open.

tasks.coveredScope: Canonical task facet and completion shared by blocks and records.
tasks.remainingGates: Current packaged/native task interactions and reviewed model task creation need their own scope-specific checks.

imports.coveredScope: ZIP/Markdown/CSV/HTML canonical import, nested preservation, reconciliation and immutable supplied provenance.
imports.remainingGates: Representative authorized Notion exports/datasets and all source-fidelity acceptance cases remain open; unsupported data stays inert.

notion-api.coveredScope: Authorized Notion API roots, versioned resumable source/schema/view reconstruction and explicit partial outcomes.
notion-api.remainingGates: Synthetic API/browser checks are not live-account evidence. Unsupported filters/templates/rollups/relations remain preserved partial outcomes; source comments/history/permissions are not inferred.

exports.coveredScope: Current-content Markdown/CSV/HTML exports and isolated rich PDF rendering.
exports.remainingGates: Live-content asset selection has targeted regression evidence; visually inspected candidate PDF and target WebView execution remain scoped gates.

assets.coveredScope: Scoped immutable hashed original assets and guarded same-volume publication.
assets.remainingGates: Windows source and test compilation do not establish native ACL/publication behavior; full recovery durability remains unavailable.

recovery.coveredScope: Page/trash/meeting restoration, historical-value mapping, incremental online backups and pre-migration snapshots.
recovery.remainingGates: Independent clean-install restore, fault/power-loss and cross-platform portability remain open. Windows new-workspace, migration, backup, restore and transfer are explicitly unavailable.

retrieval.coveredScope: FTS plus sqlite-vec retrieval, index generations, source citations and exact-token context assembly.
retrieval.remainingGates: Recorded retrieval and deletion tests do not imply universal answer correctness; model generation compatibility, representative workload and candidate performance remain scoped. Native be6fc81 evidence finds inline rich-text boundaries split a word in the search index; that source repair and candidate retest are still outstanding in this reviewed source.

ai-modes.coveredScope: 14 fixed local writing/structured modes, typed source transport, required schema grammar and reviewed action preparation.
ai-modes.remainingGates: All 14 predefined tasks passed on ab3ff13 with the optional 7B pack, not every task or native candidate. Earlier failures remain retained; broader quality, correction effort and controlled resource performance remain open.

memory.coveredScope: Approved memory scope, freshness/forgetting, current authority, exact evidence spans and held-out evaluation.
memory.remainingGates: Optional 7B passes strict fixed/held-out cases; smaller-model failures remain. Representative quality, correction effort and platform/candidate evidence remain open.

related.coveredScope: Semantic related-content cards with current citations and evidence-aware organization suggestions.
related.remainingGates: Task-specific/source and browser evidence is not broad relevance quality or native platform qualification.

meetings.coveredScope: Retained original audio, bounded normalized PCM, native transcription and reviewed meeting/voice intelligence.
meetings.remainingGates: No actual microphone activation, TCC/device/signed-app attribution or representative speech qualification is established by device-free fixtures. Target-native decoding/capture remains unqualified.

runtime.coveredScope: Pinned llama/whisper workers, leased verified model packs, protocol bounds and native process cancellation.
runtime.remainingGates: Independent clean offline installation/model acquisition, distribution rights and Windows/Linux runtime execution remain open; test compilation is source evidence only.

capture.coveredScope: Quick capture and paired browser extension with explicit destinations, source provenance and reviewed save.
capture.remainingGates: Actual Chromium fixture is scoped; interactive installation/optional permissions, physical screenshots and target OS capture remain separately unqualified.

external-index.coveredScope: Explicit selected external roots and repository indexing with identity/hash and exclusion policy.
external-index.remainingGates: Target filesystem permission/identity behavior and representative native file selection remain separate gates.

automation.coveredScope: Visible local rule/schedule/template configuration, bounded catch-up, origin rules and atomic occurrence receipts.
automation.remainingGates: Fixture/race/browser evidence does not qualify the full native candidate. Rules require Trove running; arbitrary vendor automation compatibility is excluded.

providers.coveredScope: Managed Claude/Codex discovery, account/context selection, streaming/cancellation/resume identity and reviewed handoff records.
providers.remainingGates: Real authorized inference, completed/interrupted compatible resume and actual cross-provider handoffs remain unqualified; Windows/Linux runtime containment unavailable.

mcp.coveredScope: Official SDK bridge, reviewed creation, authenticated opt-in remote MCP through owning kernel.
mcp.remainingGates: Real hosted HTTPS/client interoperability and account-scoped operations remain open; TLS SDK fixtures are narrower evidence.

image.coveredScope: Offline bounded paired vision worker, exact-original-pixel abstention, separate OCR text and generated interpretations.
image.remainingGates: Product path passes four fixed fixtures; raw model blank-image failure retained. Broader image/OCR/language/handwriting quality and target/device evidence remain open.

reviews.coveredScope: Opt-in generative cited personal reviews, deterministic fallback and separately approved page/task proposals.
reviews.remainingGates: One actual-model fixture is narrow evidence; representative scheduled-review quality and native candidate flows remain open. No generated writes commit without approval.

p2.coveredScope: Charts/forms/confirmed row actions, evidence graph, branched conversation imports and persisted display preferences.
p2.remainingGates: 4900d4b has scoped packaged P2 value/action/branch/bytes/reopen/inert-import checks. Broader package/platform qualification and newest candidate evidence remain separate.

hosting.coveredScope: Single-owner authenticated host, verified owner transfer and portable operational inactivity.
hosting.remainingGates: No network filesystem/offline multi-device sync claim. Real hosted deployment, independent recovery and Windows transfer are unqualified/unavailable.

credentials.coveredScope: OS-protected accounts, explicit access and cancellation-safe credential prompts.
credentials.remainingGates: Windows DPAPI/Linux Secret Service source and cross-compilation do not qualify actual target accounts/keyring behavior.

distribution.coveredScope: Desktop packaging, verified updates, rollback and portable build/install source paths.
distribution.remainingGates: Signing/notarization, clean installation, full offline model setup and Windows/Linux execution remain open. Ad-hoc update refusal is expected; Windows recovery is unavailable.

performance.coveredScope: Recorded startup, typed database/retrieval measurements and native worker RSS collection.
performance.remainingGates: Candidate be6fc81 returned readiness for all 20 launches but an 8399.656 ms launch exceeded its 2500 ms threshold. Keyword samples passed the 300 ms target on 100/1000/10000 synthetic pages; actual hybrid samples passed only a 100-page profile. Large semantic/concurrent load and full app latency remain open. Typed 10k formula/rollup first-page medians were 1197/1127 ms without a newly invented threshold.

governance.coveredScope: Pinned reproducible tooling, selected stack reconciliation and requirements/evidence traceability.
governance.remainingGates: Missing 307-behavior research remains unresolved. This mapping supplies scoped coverage, never automatic implementation or release approval.

release.coveredScope: Candidate and release acceptance inventory with retained failures and explicit skipped prerequisites.
release.remainingGates: Actual native UI/device, clean machines, signing, authorized representative data/accounts, hosted interoperability, startup/performance and per-platform gates remain open. Candidate be6fc81 fails the startup threshold and formatted-word search despite passing its recorded service/packaged journeys; later repairs cannot qualify that binary.

diagnostics.coveredScope: Bounded worker logs, per-root indexing diagnostics, automation run diagnostics and redacted account-token formatting.
diagnostics.remainingGates: No user-generated support-bundle flow with explicit content inclusion was located. Redacted application/job/import/model/search diagnostics as a complete system are not established by these narrower paths. Reconcile the full requirement before any implementation-complete claim.

documents.coveredScope: Bundled PDF.js viewing/text-layer extraction and isolated WebView2/WebKitGTK print/extract source paths, manifests, containment/resource policy and bounded cancellation.
documents.remainingGates: Windows/Ubuntu C++ compilation, WebView launch, real output/worker behavior, offline interception, live process/profile cleanup, install and target performance were not executed on this Mac. Chromium fixtures and Go cross-compilation are narrower source/interface evidence.

requirements.unresolvedAcceptance: Complete redacted diagnostics and the optional user-generated support bundle with explicit content selection were not located/qualified; only narrower diagnostics sources are linked.
